::: {.recipe-meta}
**Serves:** 4\
**Prep time:** 15 minutes\
**Cook time:** 1 hour, 10 minutes

[Bread]{.badge .badge-bread} [Vegetarian]{.badge .badge-vegetarian}
:::

*This will make anyone's day batter.*

## Ingredients

- 3 medium overripe bananas
- 2 Large eggs
- 1 cup buttermilk
- 1 tsp vanilla
- ½ cup vegetable oil
- 1 cup sugar
- 2½ cups flour
- 1½ tsp baking powder
- 1 tsp baking soda
- 1 tsp salt

## Instructions

*Preheat oven to 350°F.*

1. Grease a bread pan and set aside.
2. Mix all wet ingredients.
3. Mix in the dry ingredients.
4. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes.
